work.title: Real products, built from end to end.
work.body: A selection of products I have shaped, designed, built and taken to production. Each one tells a different story of turning an idea into something real.

intro.title:
From an idea
to a real digital product.
intro.body: I work directly with founders and teams through an AI-first practice: AI guides strategy, design and development so ideas become real digital products faster, from definition through launch.

about.title: An independent, AI-first studio.
about.paragraphOne: I’m Bas Bravo, a product designer and developer. Basezero is my independent, AI-first studio: I work directly with you and own the complete journey, from understanding the problem and defining the strategy through design, development and the launch of a real solution.
about.paragraphTwo: AI guides the core of my work. It is not an add-on: I use it to explore more directions, shape the product, write code, test and learn at a pace that was not possible before. My experience provides the judgment to decide what to build, what to leave out and how to turn that speed into a solid foundation.
about.paragraphThree: I work in short, open cycles instead of imposing a fixed definition or rigid management model from the start. Each version incorporates what we learn, allowing the software to grow organically and fluidly. This method works best with founders and teams who take part in decisions and want to put a useful product in front of real people early.

articles.title: Articles
articles.body: Decisions, methods and lessons on turning an idea into a useful product without adding unnecessary complexity.

farewell.title: Let’s talk about what you want to build.
farewell.body: Tell me what you want to achieve, where the project stands and whether you have a target date. I’ll reply personally so we can decide if we are a good fit.

understand.title: Define the challenge
understand.body: Together we define the objective, context, users and constraints. AI helps us explore scenarios and turn uncertainty into a shared framework for product decisions.

shape.title: Design the direction
shape.body: We model different product directions and together convert the framework into a concrete proposal: scope, architecture, experience and visual identity, with explicit priorities.

launch.title: Build the product
launch.body: I build the product’s core through an AI-first approach, linking fast cycles of design, code and testing until a functional, integrated first version is deployed.

learn.title: Validate with evidence
learn.body: We validate the solution with the business and its users transforming what we learn into concrete decisions and priorities for the next iteration.

grow.title: Evolve with purpose
grow.body: The software evolves organically: AI lets us shape each next step around what we learn, without relying on rigid planning or adding complexity before it is needed.
